scientific_integrity: One all-order structural zero-forcing criterion with a counting proof; two independent finite programs corroborate seven examples but cannot certify the infinite theorem or historical priority.
scientific_limitations: Requires finite simple underlying graphs of minimum degree at least two and girth at least five; does not apply to graphs with triangles, four-cycles, leaves, or other forcing variants. Earlier-indexed cycle-complement results and the 2014 scalar bound are credited. A closely related 2026 paper was only accessible as an abstract, leaving residual priority uncertainty.
title: Six-cycle recovery from minimum zero forcing in complements of high-girth graphs
